returns: "Tap X to punch for " + Str(PunchDamage(pts)) + " damage. Tap or hold X to rapidly punch " + int(pts + 1).toString() + " times before you need a break."
"Each punch has a " + int(pts * 10).toString() + "% chance to generate 2 Fury. Punches also do " + int(pts * 3).toString() + "% more damage."
"Punching generates waves of wind to strike enemies " + int(pts * 2).toString() + " feet further away. Punches also do " + int(pts * 2).toString() + "% more damage."
"Double-tap forward to smash through enemies for " + Str(BurroBashDamage(pts)) + " damage. This charge lasts " + Str(pts * 0.5) + " seconds, but you can stop early by tapping the opposite direction."

"If you hold X when Burro Bash hits an enemy, you\'ll grab him!  Keep X held to carry him around. " + "Release X to throw him, doing " + Str(ThrowDamage(pts)) + " damage. Giant enemies can\'t be grabbed."

"Thrown enemies bonk into other enemies, doing " + int(pts * 10).toString() + "% of the throw damage to the enemy hit. Bonked enemies may bonk other enemies as well. " + "Base throw damage is also increased by " + int(pts * 3).toString() + "%."
"Tap X while ducking to perform a rising uppercut for " + Str(PedrokenDamage(pts)) + " damage.  This knocks enemies very far away."
"Tap down while carrying an enemy and jumping to slam him into the ground, doing " + Str(PiledriverDamage(pts)) + " damage, and " + "stunning him for " + Str(pts * 0.5) + " seconds."
"Piledriver causes an explosion, doing " + Str(AtomicDamage(pts)) + " damage to enemies within " + int(5 + pts * 3).toString() + " feet. " + "This costs " + int(pts).toString() + " Fury."

"Pedroken launches a column of fire, adding " + Str(FistsOfFlameDamage(pts)) + " damage, makes you invulnerable, and has a " + int(pts * 20).toString() + "% chance to shatter armor. " + "But it now costs " + int(pts * 2).toString() + " Fury each time you do a Pedroken."
"Tap Down when injured to drop to the ground safely. In addition, each time an enemy is defeated, you have a " + int(pts * 6).toString() + "% chance to heal 1 heart."
"Pedro Punches have a " + int(pts * 4).toString() + "% chance of doing triple damage and granting " + int(pts).toString() + " Fury."
"All punch attacks inflict " + int(pts * 10).toString() + "% more damage."
"Pedro Punches electrocute the victim, shooting lightning at up to " + int(pts).toString() + " other enemies within " + int(pts * 10).toString() + " feet for " + Str(0.2 + pts * 0.2) + " damage."
"Press X in the air to jumpkick for " + Str(JumpkickDamage(pts)) + " damage."
"Kicking an enemy generates " + int(pts).toString() + " Fury. This excludes Tornado Kick hits. Also boosts damage of all kicks by " + int(pts * 3).toString() + "%."
"Jumpkicks knock enemies " + int(pts * 30).toString() + "% further away, and all kicks do " + int(pts * 3).toString() + "% more damage."
"Tap Down in the air to dive onto enemies below and bounce off for " + Str(DiveKickDamage()) + " damage. You can do this " + int(pts).toString() + " times in one jump."
"Dive Kicks hit so hard, they flatten the enemy for " + Str(0.4) + " seconds. Also increases Dive Kick damage by " + Str(pts * 0.5) + "."
"Holding Down to duck also dodges all attacks for the first " + Str(0.2 * pts) + " seconds."
"Tap X twice in the air to dash at the nearest enemy with a flying kick for " + Str(ChargeKickDamage(pts)) + " damage.  This knocks them far back."
"Tap X when injured to instantly strike back with a Dragon Kick for " + Str(RetaliateDamage()) + " damage.  This costs " + int(20 - pts * 3).toString() + " Fury."
"Gain " + int(pts * 6).toString() + "% more XP when you defeat enemies."
"Keep X held when a Flying Kick hits an enemy to perform a Tornado Kick, " + "striking up to " + int(pts).toString() + " more times for " + Str(TornadoKickDamage()) + " damage each time."
"Tornado Kick sucks in enemies from up to " + int(pts * 5).toString() + " feet away, hitting them all."
"Getting injured induces a terrible rage in Pedro, with all damage increased by " + int(pts * 8).toString() + "% for " + int(pts).toString() + " seconds."
"All kicks except Tornado Kick have a " + int(pts * 3).toString() + "% chance of doing triple damage and shattering armor."
"Defeated enemies explode, doing " + int(pts * 2).toString() + " damage to all other nearby enemies."
"Hold C and tap Down to blast all enemies onscreen for " + Str(FuriousBlastDamage(pts)) + " damage. This also shatters armor. This costs 100 Fury."
"Gain " + int(pts * 2).toString() + " Fury whenever you are injured. Also boosts the damage of abilities that cost Fury by " + int(pts * 3).toString() + "%."
"Furious Blast flings enemies away from you and destroys " + int(pts * 20) + "% of projectiles. Also increases the damage by " + int(pts * 2).toString() + "."

"Hold C, then hold Up to heal yourself.  This requires 100 Fury to start, but continues as long as you hold Up " + "and have remaining Fury. Heals 1 Heart for every " + int(20 - 3 * pts).toString() + " Fury spent."
"While Furious Fixing, you have " + int(20 * pts).toString() + "% chance to resist harm and reflect projectiles."
"Gain " + int(pts * 2).toString() + " Fury for each enemy defeated."
"Hold C and press Left to freeze all enemies for " + Str(pts * 1.5) + " seconds.  Frozen enemies thaw when hit.  This costs 100 Fury."
"Frozen enemies won\'t thaw until they are hit " + int(pts + 1).toString() + " times.  The hit that thaws them also does " + int(pts * 20).toString() + "% more damage."
"Begin each level with " + int(20 * pts).toString() + " Fury and gain 1 Fury every " + Str(3 - 0.5 * pts).toString() + " seconds."
"Hold C and press Right to go berserk, doing double damage for " + int(pts * 2).toString() + " seconds.  This costs 100 Fury."
"While in Furious Frenzy, each press of X launches a homing fireball that does " + Str(FireballDamage(pts)) + " damage."
"Gaining Fury beyond your maximum limit will heal you 1 heart for every " + int(50 - 8 * pts).toString() + " excess Fury."
"Every hit has a " + int(pts * 2).toString() + "% chance of reducing the enemy\'s current health by 20% in addition to doing its regular damage."

"When both Fury and Health are at maximum, all attacks do " + int(pts * 6).toString() + "% more damage. Also always " + "boosts the damage of abilities that cost Fury by " + int(pts * 4).toString() + "%."

"All Fury abilities have a " + int(pts * 3).toString() + "% chance to cost no Fury. Furious Fix has this chance " + "each time it heals. Also boosts the damage of abilities that cost Fury by " + int(pts * 4).toString() + "%."
